selector.rationale: The presence of subepidermal blisters with fibrin and chronic inflammatory infiltrate, along with scattered short eosinophilic bands showing apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining, strongly supports amyloidosis, especially given the patient's history of multiple myeloma.

rejected.label: Paraneoplastic pemphigus
rejected.why: Negative direct immunofluorescence test and presence of strong contradictions

rejected.label: Zinc deficiency
rejected.why: While serum zinc is low, the clinical and biopsy findings more strongly support amyloidosis
